about_the_game:
This Supporter Pack is a great way of supporting the Blender Studio <3

In return get a glimpse into our production via a hand-picked bundle of assets from our website.

Open Source Code

This game is one of our many "Open Projects", meaning it's fully open source!

With this pack you get the original game files to edit to your hearts content in Godot 4.4.
Add your own assets, change the levels or fix our bugs :P

Production Art

Get an authentic glimpse in the chaos of making a game!

We gathered together a bunch of early paintings, screen recordings, renders and paint-overs that were used during the production.

Support Open Source Development

This project aimed to test and improve Blender & Godot and how to use them together for game development in a production environment.

With your purchase you help us create more Open Projects in the future.

How to Access the Content

The DLC is downloaded into the game folder.

The easiest way to access this is by following these steps:

  • Right click on DOGWALK in your Steam Library

  • Pick Properties -> Installed Files -> Browse...

This will likely be within the Steam directory under .../steamapps/common/DOGWALK/.
